purpose: Express determination to act even through an extreme measure.
keywords: express wishes wants obligation permission request advice
I want to go home to see my family, even if it means pushing myself a little.
I want to attend this lecture even if I have to take time off work.
I will get the necessary tools, even if I have to borrow them.
restrictions: The measure is presented as a price the speaker is willing to pay.
mistake: Do not confuse it with ても “even if”.

segments.role: Express determination to act even through an extreme measure. Vて + でも
